what: Talen Energy generates and sells electricity. Its most valuable asset is the Susquehanna nuclear plant in Pennsylvania, which produces carbon-free power around the clock, exactly what data centres want.
customers: Wholesale power markets, retail electricity customers, and data centre operators contracting for power.
money: gas and coal plants and retail electricity sales
moat: A large nuclear plant with a data centre campus adjacent to it, a combination that cannot be replicated quickly because new nuclear takes a decade or more to build.
risks: It reported a loss after hedging and restructuring effects
Debt of about $9.6 billion against little cash
Power prices are volatile and determine uncontracted earnings
Regulators have scrutinised direct data centre connections to nuclear plants
opportunities: A long-term power agreement with a large technology company gives contracted nuclear revenue
Analysts see about 25% upside from current levels
watch: Data centre power agreements and forward power prices in its markets.
